slider.$description: Tokens of `slider`: its track, its thumb and its value.

gap.$description: Space between the track and the value.

track-color.$description: Color of the track after the thumb.

fill-color.$description: Color of the track before the thumb, and border of the thumb.

thumb-size.$description: Width and height of the thumb.

border-radius.$description: Corner radius of the track and of the thumb.

value-min-width.$description: Smallest width of the value: the track doesn't move when it changes.

focus-ring-offset.$description: Space between the slider and its focus ring.
